title: Poggle the Lesser
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: As the leader of the Geonosians, the being in control of the substantial Battle Droid factories, and designer of the plans for a secret super-weapon, Poggle the Lesser was a powerful figure in the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He was there at the arena to watch the execution of the Republic prisoners, but the Jedi interfered, leading to a full-scale conflict that would come to be known as the Clone Wars.
